problems.title: Two Sum
problems.statement: Given an array of integers nums and a target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.
problems.hint: Use a hashmap to store value -> index while scanning once; check for complement (target - num) at each step.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.statement: Given n non-negative integers representing heights, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water.
problems.hint: Start pointers at both ends; move the pointer at the shorter line inward, since moving the taller one can never increase area.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.statement: Given an array nums, return all unique triplets that sum to zero.
problems.hint: Sort the array, fix one element, then use two pointers on the remaining subarray to find pairs summing to the negative of the fixed element.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.statement: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
problems.hint: Maintain a window with a set/map of seen characters; shrink from the left when a duplicate is found.

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.statement: Given strings s and t, find the minimum window in s which contains all characters of t.
problems.hint: Expand the right pointer until the window is valid, then contract from the left while tracking the smallest valid window.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.statement: Given a rotated sorted array and a target, search the target and return its index or -1.
problems.hint: At each step one half of the array is guaranteed sorted; check which half is sorted, then decide which half to recurse into.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.statement: Find the minimum element in a rotated sorted array with no duplicates.
problems.hint: Compare mid with the rightmost element to decide which half contains the inflection point.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.statement: Given an integer array of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set).
problems.hint: At each index, branch into 'include' and 'exclude' recursive calls, backtracking after each choice.

problems.title: Word Search
problems.statement: Given a 2D board and a word, determine if the word exists in the grid by moving to adjacent cells.
problems.hint: DFS from each starting cell, marking visited cells temporarily and un-marking on backtrack.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.statement: Given a 2D grid of '1's (land) and '0's (water), count the number of islands.
problems.hint: BFS or DFS flood-fill from each unvisited land cell, marking connected land as visited.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.statement: Given prerequisites as a directed graph, determine if all courses can be finished (i.e., no cycle).
problems.hint: Topological sort via Kahn's algorithm (BFS with in-degree counting) or DFS cycle detection.

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.statement: You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Count distinct ways to reach the top of n stairs.
problems.hint: This is Fibonacci in disguise: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2].

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.statement: Given an integer array, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
problems.hint: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j]) for all j < i where nums[j] < nums[i]; optimize with patience sorting + binary search for O(n log n).

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.statement: Given coin denominations and an amount, find the fewest coins needed to make that amount.
problems.hint: Bottom-up dp where dp[a] = min(dp[a - coin] + 1) over all coins; initialize dp[0] = 0.

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.statement: Given an array where each element is the max jump length from that position, determine if you can reach the last index.
problems.hint: Track the farthest reachable index while iterating; if current index exceeds farthest reachable, return false.

problems.title: Gas Station
problems.statement: Given gas and cost arrays for a circular route, find the starting station index to complete the circuit, or -1.
problems.hint: If total gas >= total cost a solution exists; track running tank and reset start whenever tank goes negative.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.statement: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array.
problems.hint: Maintain a min-heap of size k while scanning; the heap top is the answer at the end.

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.statement: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
problems.hint: Push the head of each list into a min-heap keyed by value; pop the min, push its next node, repeat.

problems.title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
problems.statement: Given n nodes and a list of edges, count the number of connected components.
problems.hint: Union-Find with path compression and union by rank; count distinct roots at the end.

problems.title: Redundant Connection
problems.statement: Given a graph that was a tree with one extra edge added, find the edge that can be removed to restore a tree.
problems.hint: Process edges in order, union the endpoints; the first edge whose endpoints are already connected is the redundant one.

problems.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.statement: Given an array and integer k, find the total number of contiguous subarrays that sum to k.
problems.hint: Maintain a running prefix sum and a hashmap of prefix-sum frequencies; check for (prefix_sum - k) at each step.
